task.text:
Output me a product design guide that is easy to understand

Design guide for tech product involving AI & robotics with a cartoon theme

attempts.high: I'm putting together a product design guide for a tech product that blends AI & robotics with a cartoon theme, and I want it to be easy to understand. The whole thing is your call — invent the product concept, the cartoon style, the personality, how the design principles tie together, whatever direction feels strongest. Frame it however you think works best. Surprise me, just keep it readable.
attempts.low: I need a product design guide for an AI & robotics tech product with a cartoon theme, written so it's easy to understand. Use exactly these sections in this order: 1) Product Overview, 2) Target Users, 3) Color Palette (list 4 colors with hex codes), 4) Typography (1 heading font, 1 body font), 5) Cartoon Mascot Description, 6) Three Core Design Principles. One short paragraph per section, no extra sections, no intro or conclusion.
reasons: leakage on non-target axis 'difficulty': HIGH=4, LOW=2 (differ by 2, max allowed 1). Equalize this dimension across the two versions.
